statement: Between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-26, Saudi Arabia carries out at least one air or missile strike on Houthi-controlled territory in Yemen.
resolution: True if a Saudi official acknowledges a strike on Houthi-controlled Yemen dated 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-26, or at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP and BBC attribute such a strike to Saudi forces.
failure_condition: Saudi forces carry out no air or missile strike on Houthi-controlled territory in Yemen between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-26.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-26, the Ukrainian Air Force reports a single overnight Russian attack of at least 400 drones and missiles combined.
resolution: True if a Ukrainian Air Force report covering one night within 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-26 gives a combined drone (including decoys) and missile launch total of 400 or more, relayed by Reuters, AP or Kyiv Independent.
failure_condition: The largest single-night combined drone and missile launch total in Russian attacks on Ukraine during 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-26 is below 400.
